items.exampleEn: From her smile, I inferred that she had good news.
items.exampleZh: 從她的笑容，我推斷她有好消息。

items.exampleEn: What inference can you draw from these numbers?
items.exampleZh: 從這些數字你能得出什麼推論？

items.exampleEn: The help desk answers hundreds of queries every day.
items.exampleZh: 服務台每天要回答好幾百個詢問。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother is always willing to try new food.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶總是願意嘗試新的食物。

items.exampleEn: The museum improved my understanding of how trains work.
items.exampleZh: 這間博物館讓我更理解火車是怎麼運作的。

items.exampleEn: Try to see the problem from the customer's perspective.
items.exampleZh: 試著從顧客的角度看這個問題。

items.exampleEn: The teacher made an assessment of each student's progress.
items.exampleZh: 老師評估了每位學生的進步情況。

items.exampleEn: The theme of this year's festival is the sea.
items.exampleZh: 今年節慶的主題是海洋。

items.exampleEn: Advertising can change people's perception of a product.
items.exampleZh: 廣告能改變人們對一項產品的看法。

items.sentenceEn: If you have any queries about the order, please call us.
items.sentenceZh: 如果您對訂單有任何疑問，請打電話給我們。

items.audioEn: My manager was very understanding when I had to leave early for my son's school event.
items.audioZh: 我得提早離開去參加兒子學校的活動時，經理非常體諒。
options: The manager was kind about it
The manager left work early too

items.sentenceEn: Readers can infer a lot about the writer from this letter.
items.sentenceZh: 讀者可以從這封信推斷出很多關於寫信人的事。

items.sentenceEn: Travel gave me a new perspective on my own city.
items.sentenceZh: 旅行讓我對自己住的城市有了新的看法。

items.stemEn: Friendship is the main ____ of this novel; almost every chapter is about it.
items.stemZh: 友誼是這本小說的核心主題，幾乎每一章都和它有關。

items.stemEn: Are you ____ to help us move the desks this afternoon?
items.stemZh: 你願意今天下午幫我們搬桌子嗎？

items.passageEn: When Ms. Wang became our manager, she began with an assessment of how the team worked. She asked each of us for our perspective on the office, and she was willing to listen to criticism. One clear theme came up again and again: people felt their ideas were ignored. Ms. Wang said our perception mattered more than any report. She also set up an online form so that staff could send queries directly to her. From her actions, we could infer that she truly wanted change, and that inference turned out to be right. She has been fair and understanding, and the team is considerably happier than before.
items.passageZh: 王女士成為我們的經理後，先評估了團隊的工作方式。她問我們每個人對辦公室的看法，也很願意聽取批評。有一個主題一再出現：大家覺得自己的意見被忽略了。王女士說，我們的看法比任何報告都重要。她也設立了線上表單，讓員工可以直接向她提出疑問。從她的行動，我們可以推斷她真心想要改變，而這個推論後來證明是對的。她一直很公平、很體諒人，團隊比以前快樂許多。

questions.questionZh: 王經理上任後先做了什麼？
options: 重新裝潢整間舊辦公室

questions.questionZh: 員工一再提到的問題是什麼？
options: 每天的工作時間實在太長
覺得自己的意見被忽略
辦公室離大家住的地方太遠

items.promptZh: 顧客對我們公司的看法非常重要。
referenceEn: Customers' perception of our company is very important.
Our customers' perception of the company matters a lot.
rubricZh: perception 是名詞，常用 perception of…（例如 perception of our company）
「非常重要」可寫 is very important、matters a lot 等

items.instructionZh: 用 willing 造一個句子，說說你願意為工作或家人做的一件事。
referenceEn: I am willing to work late if my team needs help.
I'm willing to drive my parents to the airport at five in the morning.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 willing，常用 be willing to＋動詞（例如 am willing to work）
